# Test fixtures

Every `*.txt` file here is a **SYNTHETIC** screen written by hand to match the
best-known prompt shapes of each agent. **None of them was captured from a real
session** (see docs/spike-notes.md: no blocked screens have been captured yet).
They exist to exercise the parser and must not be treated as evidence of what
the agents really print. Replace them with real captures, and flip the
profiles to `verified = true`, once real blocked screens exist.
